lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: In drawing all editable geometry types, ruler and both azimuth modes, tap with small drift on several screen densities.
Drag beyond threshold then return, long press, cancel and pinch; compare normal camera pan and endpoint/vertex drag.
Select editable and read-only objects from different layers; clear by empty-map tap, toolbar and Back.
Activate overflow actions on phone, tablet, landscape, split screen and increased display/font sizes.
value.expected: One short micro-drift tap creates one point without camera shift; deliberate gestures create none; actions are immediate only for editable selection and clear with selection.
